tei:div.tei:p: (na)༄༅// phyi nang gsang gsum gyi maṇ+ḍal 'bul chog bzhugs// ༄༅// bla ma dam pa'i zhabs la gus pas phyag 'tshal lo// maṇ+ḍal 'bul bar 'dod pas mdun gyi nam mkhar bla ma dang yi dam gyi lha/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyis bskor ba spyan drangs nas bzhugs pa la/ maṇ+ḍal 'bul ba la gsum las/ dang po phyi kun rdzob rdzas kyi maṇ+ḍal ni/ dpal gsang ba 'dus pa las/ zhing 'di rin chen bdun rnams kyis// mkhas pa dag gis yongs bkang ste// dngos grub 'dod pas dngos grub phyir// shes rab can gyi nyin re dbul// zhes pas sa 'am rdo 'am rin po che la sogs pa khru gang las mi chung ba la/ dri bzang gi chus byugs par byas te/ 'og thams cad gser gyi sa gzhir bsam/ dngos po rnam par dag pa me tog gtsang mas dbus su ri'i rgyal po ri rab/ shar shel/ lho in+d+ra nī la/ nub pad+ma rā ga byang gser las grub pa/ lcog chen po brgyad kyi nye bar mdzes par byas pa dang*/ yang shar lus 'phags po/ lho 'dzam bu gling*/ nub ba lang spyod/ byang sgra mi snyan/ shar dang dbus kyi bar nyi ma/ dbus dang nub kyi bar du zla ba/ steng du lha dang mi'i longs spyod phun sum tshogs pa/ gzhan yang rgyal srid rin po che sna bdun/ 'dod 'jo'i ba/ ma rmos pa'i lo tog dpag bsam gyi shing*/ gser dngul dang*/ 'bru dang*/ zas gos la sogs pa dngos po bzang la gya nom pa/ bsam gyis mi khyab pas gang bar bsam zhing*/ lus thal mo sbyar la/ ngag tu/ zhing khams rnam par dag pa 'di// dbus kyi ri rgyal ri rab la// gling bzhi 'dod yon lnga yis brgyan// nyi ma zla bas skor ba byed// lha mi'i longs spyod phun sum tshogs// rgyal srid rin chen rnam pa bdun// 'dod 'jo'i ba dang dpag bsam shing*// ma rmos lo tog gser dang dngul// 'bru bzang longs spyod bsam mi khyab// dngos po bzang la gya nom pa// bla ma sangs rgyas rnams la 'bul// rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas thob par shog

/oṃ gu ru bud+dha bo dhi sa twa maṇ+ḍa la pū dza me gha sa mu dra s+phar ṇa sa ma ye hūm̐ zhes brjod de/ 'dod pa'i don gang yin pa gsol ba btab la bsngo ba bya/ rten gshegs su gsol ba'am/ mi dmigs par rang la bsdu gang rung bya'o// me tog dman pa dben pa'i gnas su gzhag par bya'o// gnyis pa nang don dam rdo rje lus kyi maṇ+ḍal ni he badz+ra las/ ji ltar phyi rol de bzhin nang*// sdom pa'i de nyid rab tu phye// zhes gsungs pas/ rang gi dge sbyor gyi rgyun thon pa dang*/ lus kyi gtso bo snying bla ma lhag pa'i lhar bsams te/ pags pa gser gyi sa gzhi/ khrag chu'i byug pa/ sgal tshigs ri'i rgyal po ri rab/ yan lag bzhi gling bzhi/ rtsa ro rkyang gnyis nyi ma dang zla ba/ nyi ma ltar dmar ba gser/ zla ba ltar dkar ba dngul/ byang chub kyi sems lha dang mi'i lus phun sum tshogs pa/ snying ma gtogs pa'i don rnam pa lnga/ snod rnams gcig tu bsdoms pa dang*/ drug snod la gnas pa'i bde ba'i cha dang bdun/ rgyal srid rin po che sna bdun/ spyi bo'i haṃ las byang chub kyi sems 'bab pa 'dod 'jo'i ba/ lus la sku gsum rang chas su yod pa ma rmos pa'i lo tog rtsa dpag bsam gyi shing*/ gzhan yon tan gyi cha dpag tu med pa yod pa rnams/ zas gos dang*/ 'bru dang longs spyod la sogs par bsam par bya'o// de ltar bsam ste sngar gyi tshigs su bcad pa dang*/ sngags kyis phul te 'dod pa'i don la gsol ba gdab par bya'o// gsum pa gsang ba zung 'jug sems kyi maṇ+ḍal ni/ dbang yon tan rim pa las/ rang sems bla mar snang ba de// gnyis med slob dpon dam pa'o// zhes bshad pas/ rang gi sems mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub thams cad kyi rtsa ba'am/ gzhir gyur pa ni bla ma yi dam gyi lha yin pas maṇ+ḍal ni kun gzhi 'khor 'das kyi rgyur gyur pa gser gyi sa gzhi/ de snying rje byang chub kyi sems dang ma bral ba/

chu'i byugs pa/ chos thams cad kyi rtsa ba ri'i rgyal po ri rab/ de las tshad med pa bzhi skye ba ni gling bzhi/ thabs shes rab zung 'brel tu nyams su len pa nyi zlas skor ba byed pa/ gzhan don rgyun mi chad pa 'byung ba 'dod 'jo'i ba/ longs sku spros pa dang bral ba ma rmos pa'i lo tog sku dang ye shes/ mdzad pa dang phrin las la sogs pa thams cad dpag bsam gyi shing dang*/ 'bru dang longs spyod la sogs par bsam ste/ yang snga ma'i tshigs su bcad pa dang*/ sngags kyis phul la/ 'dod pa'i don la gsol ba gdab par bya'o// gang la mkhas pa 'jug pa'i sgo// lus can zhi bar bgrod pa'i lam// lha mi'i longs spyod sgrub pa'i thabs// rnam dag lus kyis bstan par bya// kyu ra'i dbon po dpon g.yog gis// gus pas gsol ba btab pa'i ngor// sde snod 'dzin pa dpal ldan sa skya paṇ+ḍi tas/ dpal bsam yas lhun gyis grub pa'i gtsug lag khang du bris pa'o// bstan pa dang sems can la phan thogs par gyur cig/ // ༈ gu rus dpar rtsa spel ba'o//
